svg.title: MediaLog — Light reading symbol
svg.desc: An open book traced by a light synthesizer: the trail is mirrored across the gutter, and every seed along it has expanded outward in chunky cells through amber, orange-red, violet and a fading blue, so the outline glows in rainbow ripples round clear pages and amber lines of text. Primary brand colour #18223a, plain MediaLog wordmark. The light synth’s mirrored, expanding seeds draw the book itself: the trail is the outline, the ripples its glow; Mirror symmetry about the gutter replaces the four-fold mandala, and there is no black screen or tile.
